**Site 05 (Seoul) — Grade-3 SAE Entries:**

Serious adverse events must be reported to the sponsor within 24 hours of the investigator becoming aware of the event. Grade-3 events classified as SAEs under ICH E2A require expedited processing. The electronic data capture system serves as the authoritative record for all adverse event data and supersedes any derived or summarised documents produced by the CRO.
